questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

Tests practical understanding of per-tenant TLS in CNF gateways, including CSR workflows, in-cluster signing, and secure TLS termination at the gateway. Emphasizes using Kubernetes Secrets for certificates and small manifests for end-to-end validation.

## Key Concepts

- mTLS in CNF gateways
- per-tenant CA and secret management
- CSR signing in-cluster
- sidecar certificate injection

## Code Example

```yaml
# TenantCredential secret (example)
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: tenant1-credential
type: kubernetes.io/tls
data:
  tls.crt: <base64-cert>
  tls.key: <base64-key>

# Per-tenant CA bundle secret
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: tenant1-ca
type: Opaque
data:
  ca.crt: <base64-ca>

# One-namespace test manifest
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cnf-gw-tenant1
  namespace: tenant1
spec:
  replicas: 1
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        image: cnf/gateway:latest
        ports:
        - containerPort: 443
        volumeMounts:
        - name: ca-volume
          mountPath: /etc/ssl/certs
      - name: sidecar-mtls
        image: cnf/sidecar-mtls:latest
        volumeMounts:
        - name: ca-volume
          mountPath: /etc/tenant-ca
      volumes:
      - name: ca-volume
        secret:
          secretName: tenant1-ca
```

```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
metadata:
  name: gateway-rollout-tenant-a
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: gateway
      tenant: a
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: gateway
        tenant: a
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        image: registry.example.com/cnf/gateway:latest
  strategy:
    canary:
      steps:
      - setWeight: 10
      - pause: { duration: 5m }
      - setWeight: 100
      analysis:
        templates:
        - templateName: canary-metrics
        metrics:
        - name: latency
          interval: 30s
          successCondition: result < 0.001 * 0.15
        - name: error-rate
          interval: 30s
          successCondition: result < 0.005
```

```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: AnalysisTemplate
metadata:
  name: canary-metrics
spec:
  metrics:
  - name: latency
    provider:

        url: http://prometheus.k8s.svc
        query: sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_sum[5m])) / sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count[5m]))
  - name: error-rate
    provider:
      prometheus:
        url: http://prometheus.k8s.svc
```
